newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Onur Air appoints Kales as Dutch cargo agent.
newsitem.headline: Onur Air appoints Kales as Dutch cargo agent.

text.p: AMSTERDAM, April 14 Reuter) - Turkish carrier Onur Airlines said it has chosen Kales Airline Service BV as its Dutch cargo general sales agent.
Director and owner of Kales, Peter Kales, said Onur operates three-times-a-week between the Netherlands and Turkey.
The airline flies on Tuesdays and Fridays from Amsterdam Schiphol airport to Istanbul and on Thursdays from Eindhoven to Izmir.
Onur's flights are either operated with an A320, which has a 10-tonne cargo capacity, or an A321, which can carry between four and five tonnes.
Currently, the airline is flying during the summer season, from April until October, but is hoping to operate all year round in the future, said Kales.
At Schiphol, the airline will be handled by Ogden Aviation.
MSAS Cargo International, Muller, AEI and Road Air will undertake trucking on behalf of Onur in the Netherlands.
Onur also flies out of several cities in Germany, where its cargo gsa is Aerotrans .
